Ryan (CTO): Starting a short thread for runtime Qs after today's all-hands. Keep items small so we can assign.
Sophie (Runtime Eng): Will answer batching/caching questions. If related to Console UX tag Priya.
Jules (EngOps): What's the concrete metric combo that triggers autoshrink? p95 queue wait alone?
Sophie (Runtime Eng): We use a hybrid: p95 queue-wait > X AND pool-util < Y => shrink. Also route SLO tag can override to force latency-first.
Tomas (Kernel): Kernel note: fused-attn prototype gives ~1.5x on 6k seq in microbench. Canary next week.
Mira (SRE): Concern: first-run JIT caused ~250ms blips. Plan to pre-warm on canary nodes?
Tomas (Kernel): Yes, pre-warm PTX cache + async JIT thread. That should minimize stalls.
Priya (Product): UX: we'll surface a simple latency<>throughput toggle per-route and an advanced YAML editor. Does that map to runtime knobs?
Sophie (Runtime Eng): Yes. Toggle maps to max_wait_ms, batch_window_pct, and fallback aggressiveness. We'll publish mapping doc.
Jules (EngOps): Please paste a tiny YAML example we can include in the runbook.
Sophie (Runtime Eng): Short example pasted: 
```yaml
route: /chat/low-latency
slo: latency
batching:
  max_wait_ms: 10
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
fallbacks:
  - kernel_swap
  - reduce_batch_window
  - model_variant: quant-8
```
Mira (SRE): I'll schedule a canary with pre-warm and dashboards for jit/p95/p99.
ping-bot: Follow-up created: ah-runtime-followups (owners: Sophie, Tomas, Priya, Jules, Mira).
Ryan (CTO): Thanks all. We'll fold into the FAQ and link from the all-hands notes. Drop other short Qs here. :thumbsup:
